symptom: The nightly goes red on the Mendix 10.24.24 leg only, in `TestRoundtripRestClient_WithQueryParams`: `want the QueryParameters refusal, got: query: ( … ) on a REST operation requires Mendix 11.0.0+ (project is 10.24.24.119349)`. Every 11.x leg, push CI and the unit tests are green
cause: Not a product defect: the statement is still refused below 11.0, by a different layer. 9aa1df3e (ako/mxcli#1811 sweep) added a check-time gate, `rest_client_query_params` in documentTypeGates, which refuses the statement before the write is reached, while the test pinned the write path's refusal text (`Rest$RestOperation.QueryParameters (Mendix 11.0.0+)`). Only a pre-11.0 project takes that branch (`restClientHasMendix11Shapes`), and per-PR CI runs one newer version, so the PR that added the gate never ran it
insight: A test that pins a write-time refusal is a bet that nothing refuses earlier, and moving a refusal to check time is exactly the direction CLAUDE.md asks for, so every check-time gate added should grep the integration tests for the write path's message (`cannot store <Type>.<Property>` / `<Type>.<Property> (Mendix X+)`) and move those assertions to the gate's `<feature> requires Mendix X+`. The 9.24 leg cannot show this one: there `create rest client` itself is gated (10.1), which fires first and was already among that leg's 69 known failures, the same count before and after the gate landed. Reproduce in about 10s: `mxcli setup mxbuild --version 10.24.24.119349`, then `MX_BINARY=~/.mxcli/mxbuild/10.24.24.119349/modeler/mx go test -tags integration -run 'TestRoundtripRestClient_WithQueryParams$' ./mdl/executor/`. Controls: the old assertion fails at line 151 with the nightly's exact message; the new one passes, and fails with the write path's `cannot store Rest$RestOperation.QueryParameters (Mendix 11.0.0+)` when the gate's applies is stubbed to false
